categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Forecam Optics Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of special and civilian optical lenses, optoelectronic systems, and optical components. Its product portfolio includes customized products mainly for aerospace, space observation, guidance, naval, aviation, and high-end equipment sectors, and non-customized products such as security monitoring lenses, automotive lenses, infrared lenses, machine vision lenses, and projection optical engines serving smart city, IoT, automotive networking, and AR/VR markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced optical design and precision manufacturing technologies including large-aperture transmissive astronomical lenses, complex zoom optical system design, multi-spectral co-aperture lens production, miniaturized fixed and zoom aspheric lens design with automated production, and precision and ultra-precision optical processing. It maintains a vertically integrated production process from mold making, mechanical processing, plastic injection molding, lens cold processing, to lens and optoelectronic system assembly and testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include Chinese national aerospace programs (e.g., Shenzhou, Chang'e, Tianwen missions), Chinese Academy of Sciences, major research institutes, and enterprises in aerospace and defense. The company also serves global security equipment manufacturers, automotive component suppliers, and emerging markets in smart security, automotive ADAS, machine vision, AR/VR, and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Fujian Province. It has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Germany (Innovision GmbH) serving as a bridgehead for European market cooperation and technology exchange. Its products are sold domestically and internationally, with export sales accounting for a significant portion of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fujian Forecam Optics operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the optical industry supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of optical lenses and optoelectronic systems. It controls the entire production process from raw material processing to final product assembly, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in optical components and systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes sustained high R&D investment focusing on frontier technologies such as large-aperture astronomical lenses, complex zoom systems, multi-spectral optical systems, and miniaturized aspheric lenses. It actively participates in national key R&D projects, advances technology platforms covering short-, medium-, and long-term innovation, and accelerates product upgrades in aerospace, commercial space, infrared imaging, machine vision, and projection optics. Digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and international collaboration are key strategic themes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized and non-customized optical products and systems. The company follows an order-driven production model, with pricing based on negotiation and cost-plus methods for customized products, and direct sales contracts for non-customized products. It also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and leasing of idle assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fujian Forecam Optics is a leading domestic manufacturer in the special and civilian optical lens industry with global competitiveness in large-aperture astronomical lenses and complex zoom optical systems. It holds multiple industry firsts and proprietary technologies, positioning itself as a key supplier for national aerospace and defense projects and a strong competitor in smart security and automotive optical markets. It faces competition from both domestic and international optical component manufacturers, especially in the non-customized product segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 621 million, a 5.82% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 9.49 million. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around RMB 2.57 billion and net assets of RMB 1.7 billion. R&D investment remains robust at over 10% of revenue, supporting sustained growth and innovation. The company has improved gross margins and operational efficiency, signaling a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fujian Forecam Optics emphasizes its deep military-civil fusion technology heritage, advanced proprietary optical design and manufacturing capabilities, and comprehensive product portfolio covering full spectral ranges from ultraviolet to long-wave infrared. Its vertically integrated production and strong R&D capabilities enable high precision, reliability, and customization for critical aerospace and defense applications, as well as competitive, high-quality products for civilian markets. The company’s innovation-driven approach and strategic international partnerships further differentiate it in the global optical industry.
